text:
Penny Li: Hi team! Penny here, starting today as a frontend engineer. Came from Austin, I code by day and make sourdough by night. Also I have a very well-behaved corgi. Quick qs: is it cool to bring the pup to the office occasionally? Any lunchtime pizza traditions?

Nico (People Ops): Welcome Penny!! :tada: We have a pet policy — short visits are OK but please clear with your floor lead and keep pups on leash in common areas. I'll DM you the form to add your dog to the office roster. Pizza tradition: once a month we do "Pizza Friday" with rotating toppings.

Juno: welcome!! :wave: Love corgis. Also FYI there's a whiteboard outside the kitchen for signups if you want to bring the dog on a particular day.

Diego: hi Penny 44b If you want to join the pizza rotation, add a note to the #lunch channel or ping me. I make a mean margherita.

Penny Li: yay margherita sounds perfect. Thanks for the heads up on the form, Nico. Also where's the best place to put a small box for mail/packages?

Nico (People Ops): There's a labeled shelf by security for new hire packages. We'll also leave a welcome sticker pack and a hoodie on your desk.

welcome-bot: Welcome Penny! You've been added to #new-hires and the "Summer 2026" onboarding cohort. Onboarding checklist: 1) Badge & access 2) Security training 3) Pairing session with mentor.

Sam: welcome Penny! If you bring the corgi I will bring puppuccinos 436366 Also we have a casual meme thread in #random if you want dog pics.

Penny Li: I will absolutely bring dog pics 60a Also thanks everyone, excited to meet the team in person and join Pizza Friday :pizza:
